source.origin: Current tested complete VTT runtime copy

review.note: Never refresh this hash automatically in CI. This is the complete runtime baseline; it is wrapped as a full initializer without hook or API projection.

differences.name: longRestCleanup compatibility shim
differences.summary: cleanupReversibleHitPointCapacity accepts an options object and skips the second current-hit-point adjustment when the host deletes a registered reversible-capacity effect with {longRestCleanup: true}; rebalance and ordinary expiry paths are unchanged.

differences.name: Bardic Inspiration visibility status
differences.summary: Granted Bardic Inspiration effects carry the arcane-bardic-inspiration status, and Hooks.once('setup') registers the matching CONFIG.statusEffects entry with the module drum.svg icon after dnd5e resets the status list. The effect and its consumption stay owned by the runtime; the status only drives token visibility.

differences.name: Dread Ambusher effect icon
differences.summary: The Dread Ambusher effect uses the module game-icons shadow-follower.svg path instead of the legacy Nicons/Ability_Ambush.png path.

differences.name: First-party HP pool ownership handshake
differences.summary: applyHitPointPoolAllocatorFromUse recognizes the first-party hp-pool-runtime settlement receipt (__mtHpPoolProcessed + a strictly shaped __mtHpPool). A successful receipt applies the compiler artifact exactly once to the host's affectedTokens, matching pool.affected tokenIds in order and requiring each token to be a real workflow target with an actor; it never rolls again or posts a pool card. Failed and empty receipts apply no artifact. A malformed or inconsistent receipt throws before any roll, artifact or message.

differences.name: First-party independent-projectile ownership handshake
differences.summary: applyIndependentProjectilesFromUse skips its own projectile chain only when the real workflowOptions (or usage midiOptions) carries __mtProjectileOwner, which first-party projectileCastUsage sets on the parent and every child. The runtime direct path, its child guard and receipts are unchanged.

differences.name: Compiler zone pulse macro isolation
differences.summary: executeCompilerZoneEventActivity marks its hidden compiler pulse use with midiOptions.workflowOptions.noOnUseMacro = true. Midi reads OnUse macros from the whole Item (and actor), and the compiler installs the ActiveAuras template binder at Item level for the cast that places the zone template; the pulse owns no template, so re-running that binder there threw 'ActiveAuras template provenance is unavailable' and skipped the native save/damage. The pulse still resolves its own hidden save/damage activity, ordinary cast and following-aura paths keep their macros, and a compiler pulse carries no legitimate OnUse macro on either scope, which is the accepted boundary.

differences.name: Compiler zone template deletion keeps concentration
differences.summary: preDeleteMeasuredTemplate sets options.noConcentrationCheck = true only when isCompilerPersistentAuraTemplate(templateDocument) is true, i.e. an ActiveAuras aura entry with persistentTemplate and compiler artifact ids. Midi's checkDeleteTemplate deletes the dependent source effect, and therefore concentration, when the last dependent template is deleted; compiler persistent zones are owned by the existing deleteMeasuredTemplate membership cleanup and TimesUp expiry instead. Non-compiler templates keep Midi's native behaviour, and cleanupCompilerZoneMembershipOnTemplateDelete is unchanged.
